column3: (CSP header not set: only robots.txt and other plain-text files; pages are checked by check-deployment.mjs)
(CSP style-src 'unsafe-inline': accepted, React/Radix set inline styles; scripts need the per-page nonce)
(Anti-CSRF tokens in forms: forms are sent by JavaScript as JSON with the X-XSRF-TOKEN header; a form post without JavaScript reaches no API)
